The moonmelon party needed guests, and Ada wanted every card to arrive neat as a button.","when":[]},{"text":"Ada looked up and found the invitations pinned high on the roof post. “Oh dear,” she said. “The wind has made a bulletin board!”","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Ada peeked into the wicker basket and discovered a paper lantern nestled beside the invitations. Its moon-shaped handle tickled her nose.","when":[{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"Pip stretched his wings toward the roof tiles. Ada noticed that he was imagining a grand flying delivery, although she had imagined something much neater.","when":[{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"initial"}]},{"text":"The invitations waited on the little party table, the basket was plain, and Pip had his quietest toes ready. Ada smiled. This might be a wonderfully ordinary delivery.","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"},{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"},{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"initial"}]}],"scenes":[{"scene":"observe_pin","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada shaded her eyes and inspected the tall post. She discovered that the wind had pinned the three invitations there, fluttering like tiny white flags.","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Ada inspected the tall post. No invitations were pinned there; they were still waiting safely on the party table.","when":[{"key":"post.invites_pinned","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"observe_cargo","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada opened the basket and discovered a paper lantern tucked among the invitations. “A glow-up for our party!” she whispered.","when":[{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Ada opened the basket and discovered only the invitations inside. “Plain and ready,” she said, giving the basket a pleased little tap.","when":[{"key":"basket.contains_lantern","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"observe_belief","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada watched Pip’s wings wobble with excitement and discovered that he was expecting a grand flying delivery. His tail drew imaginary loops in the air.","when":[{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Ada watched Pip fold his wings carefully and discovered that he was not expecting a flying delivery. His toes stood ready for a quiet job.","when":[{"key":"pip.believes_flight","op":"eq","value":false,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_plan","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada faced Pip. “I want the invitations delivered neatly,” she said. “No card upside down, no guest chased by a dragon, and only a teeny-tiny flourish.” Pip listened closely.","when":[{"key":"pip.knows.ada.want","op":"eq","value":"neat","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"transfer_ribbon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada handed Pip the blue ribbon. Pip held it between two careful claws. “A ribbon for a ribbon-worthy mission!” he declared.","when":[{"key":"ribbon.owner","op":"eq","value":"pip","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tie_ribbon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip tied the blue ribbon around the wind-pinned invitations. The roof post suddenly looked dressed for dancing, and the cards stopped flapping like startled minnows.","when":[{"key":"post.ribboned","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"pin_invites","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada pressed the invitations neatly against the ribboned roof post. “There,” she said. “A delivery with its shoes polished.”","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"post","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"lift_basket","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip lifted the plain basket with extremely serious dragon toes. “I can carry a basket without tickling it!” he announced, while Ada tried not to laugh at his solemn face.","when":[{"key":"basket.owner","op":"eq","value":"pip","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"set_down_basket","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"At the moonmelon trellis, Pip set the basket down and smoothed one bent-looking—though perfectly sound—handle. Ada gathered the invitations for the next step.","when":[{"key":"basket.owner","op":"eq","value":"ada","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"carry_plain","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada carried the plain invitations along the quiet roof-garden path. Pip marched beside her, whispering, “Left foot, right foot, absolutely no dramatic swooping.”","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"walk","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"carry_to_trellis","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada carried the basket beneath the moonmelon trellis. The paper lantern stayed safe among the invitations, waiting like a sleepy moon for its evening glow.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"lantern","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"light_lantern","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada lit the paper lantern beside the delivered invitations. Warm gold spilled over the trellis, and every moonmelon seemed to grow a little smile.","when":[{"key":"lantern.lit","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_pip_quiet","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Ada told Pip, “I know you hoped for a grand flight. My neat plan can have one small flourish.” Pip’s eyes grew round. “A tidy swoop?” he asked.","when":[{"key":"pip.belief","op":"eq","value":"neat","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"agree_flight","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip understood at last. “Neat first, spectacular second?” he asked. Ada nodded. “A tiny air-mail show.” Pip tucked the ribbon close and grinned with all his little dragon teeth.","when":[{"key":"pip.performance_agreed","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"flap_delivery","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip swept upward in one careful flap. The three invitations floated down on the blue ribbon, looping once around the trellis before landing exactly where Jun could catch them.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"flight","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"return_ribbon","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Pip returned the blue ribbon to Ada with a bow so deep that his nose brushed the roof tiles.","when":[{"key":"ribbon.owner","op":"eq","value":"ada","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"jun_accepts","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Jun climbed into the roof garden, holding an invitation high. “Splendid delivery!” Jun called, whether it had arrived by post, path, or dragon-powered air.","when":[{"key":"jun.invited","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"jun_sees_delivery","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Jun looked from the invitation to Ada and Pip. Ting! The moonmelon party began, bright and bouncy beneath the open sky.","when":[{"key":"garden.party_ready","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]}],"endings":[{"text":"The ribboned invitations fluttered on the roof post while Jun climbed up laughing, one hand raised to catch the next little shiver of paper.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"post","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The roof post wore its blue ribbon proudly. Jun arrived laughing beneath it, and the invitations bobbed overhead like three tiny flags.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"post","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The lit lantern glowed under the trellis, and the invitations rested safely beside its moon-shaped handle. Gold light trembled on Jun’s delighted cheeks.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"lantern","at":"after"},{"key":"lantern.lit","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"Under the glowing trellis lantern, Jun found the invitations beside the moon-shaped handle and reached for one as the light hummed softly.","when":[{"key":"invites.route","op":"eq","value":"lantern","at":"after"},{"key":"lantern.lit","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]},{"text":"The blue ribbon looped through the air as Pip landed beside Jun, who held the invitation like a tiny flag.
